before: A fragment paste always pushed its own package undo unit and published its journal without a history group. Pasted registered blocks kept their source tags, so the block index reported duplicate references.
after: A fragment paste carries the history group of the commit in flight into its package unit and journal. The private block clipboard adds a payload flavour, pastes native flavours, and retags pasted blocks with fresh IDs and payload records in the same undo step.
reason: The history group already travels in local history and in the existing journal field. Retagging uses existing content-control and custom XML writes. No shared format field, identity rule, or transport message changes.
